title: Repair and Emergency Service Calls — Deposit Reduction for a Harbison Installation by Contract Price
content:
For a special-order part on a call under Repair and Emergency Service Calls, a customer who bought a system from Harbison earns a deposit reduction in points off the deposit rate. The record read is the customer's installation project in closed status under Replacement System Installations, and the contract price written on it.

**Rule.** A customer whose closed Harbison installation carried a contract price of 12,000 dollars or more earns a deposit reduction of 10 points. One whose closed Harbison installation carried a lower contract price earns 5 points. A customer with no closed Harbison installation earns no reduction.

| Closed Harbison installation, contract price | Deposit reduction |
|---|---|
| 12000.00 dollars or more | 10 points |
| Below 12000.00 dollars | 5 points |
| No closed Harbison installation | None |

## Boundaries

- A contract price of $12,000.00 earns 10 points. A contract price of $11,999.99 earns 5.
- A signed or scheduled installation that has not closed earns no reduction.
